fails_if: inspect_bundle_source_records (and the report model's completeness check) marks a report incomplete because it holds a pooled-period issue, although only an unparseable period leaves an observation's edition unknown
note: The two old [pooled] parameters in one bundle with no unparseable period: AmPolTyp cvid 1 (VarId 31619, variant 153) named in 2020 and cvid 2, a blank on its VarId with the pooled period 2020-2021; OnlyScb cvid 11 (VarId 9, variant 152) named in 2019 and cvid 12, a blank with the pooled period 2018-2019. The workbook is the unedited synthetic one. The old tests claimed both the full and the filtered report complete; `witnesses-outside-a-finite-comparison` holds unparseable periods beside the pooled ones, so its reports are incomplete and cannot carry this claim. Each pooled issue is not incomplete, and each pooled blank stays an unknown-applicability witness, never a target.
